notes.title: Happy 2nd Anniversary!
notes.notes:
[i]The 2-year anniversary website has just launched!ːsteamhappyː A huge birthday cake, a commemorative card, sneak peeks of future plans, community events... Come and celebrate with Infinity Kingdom![/i]

[b]Make a Cake:[/b] let’s decorate IK’s birthday cake together. After decorating, you can get an exclusive Chat Msg Box, as well as a Nameplate if you share this event. Additionally, all lords will receive rewards when the total number of decorations reaches a specific number!
[b]Commemorative Card:[/b] get your exclusive memory letter, and after reading it, don’t forget to claim the exclusive birthday Avatar Frame!


[b]How to Participate:[/b]
1. Visit the page directly 【[url=https://case.gtarcade.com/en/ik/2ndanniv.html]https://case.gtarcade.com/en/ik/2ndanniv.html[/url]】and log in with your ID to participate in the celebration. （As Facebook does not support landscape display, please open this link with your browser and view this page horizontally）
2. Tap the cake button at the top right corner of the main page in the game, and tap “Annual Memoirs” to reach the special page without entering your ID.
Spread the news that it’s Infinity Kingdom’s birthday and invite your friends to celebrate with us! Comment your ID and Lucasta will randomly choose 10 players to send a small gift to. Until the end of this event, each time the total number of shares for this post increases by 100, Lucasta will choose 5 more players! (For example, if the total number of shares is 270, the total number of gifts will be 10+2×5=20 players)


Each participant and ID can only receive one reward, this event is only available on Facebook. Rewards will be sent in-game via mail within 48 hours after the event ends, the event ends on February 23.

notes.title: Come and Join Our Snow Festival Event!
notes.notes:
Finally, we are reaching the end of 2022. We wish you all a peaceful weekend and a good time with your most precious family and friends!

Snow Festival has started (servers that have been open for 7 days or more can participate). Collect Reindeer Gingerbread and Snow Hats to redeem wonderful rewards!

Also, we hosting some events on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/InfinityKingdomOfficial]Facebook page[/url], welcome to join us and share your happy moments.ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Thanksgiving Limited Event!
notes.notes:
A new element and a new rarity!😍 Loki, a Legendary Chaos Magic Bowman, enters the fray!🔥 

Thanksgiving again!❤️ We’d like to thank everyone for their love and support for Infinity Kingdom from 2021 to 2022, and let you all experience the new Chaos element.💫 Happy Thanksgiving, and here’s Loki, free to summon!💝 Simply take part in the Call to Supremacy event to easily obtain Loki! 


▌How to Obtain:
① Take part in the Call to Supremacy event and log in to acquire Loki! (Players in Season 2 will receive Loki in full. Players who have not reached Season 2 will receive an equivalent amount of Loki fragments, allowing them to summon Loki after reaching Season 2.)
② Loki fragments will appear in Chaos Roulette, Primitive Chaos, and Festival Events. Check your server's Calendar to keep track of the latest event schedule.
③ Take part in our [url=https://www.facebook.com/106109130991058/posts/pfbid02rqWxANeDgRY425Zb6z85JLZaxH7pB9jghCWUWWdfG83MF2gWbp797ShzyDZ3aiYSl/?d=n]Facebook event[/url] for a chance to obtain Loki! Lucasta has a collection of Loki fragments ready to be given away to lucky players!

notes.title: Come and join our Ghost Fiesta Event! (Oct. 30 - Nov. 4)
notes.notes:
Ghost Fiesta has already started! Welcome to visit Norheim from October 30 to November 4 and join the  special event for Halloween with us~

 
☀️〓Daily Sign-in〓: Log in daily to claim a valuable gift. 
✅〓Festival Missions〓: Complete the Festival Missions to earn candy ingredients: Spider Webs🕸 or Birdie Egg🥚. Collect points to unlock Progress Chests containing Raspberry Jam🍯(another candy ingredient) and other wonderful rewards. 
🎃〓Special Drops〓: During the event, there is a chance of obtaining Ghost Fiesta Chests when collecting and gathering resources, and defeating Gnome Units and Gnome Bosses. Ghost Fiesta Chests contain ingredients needed to make Strange Candy: Raspberry Jam, Spider Webs, and Birdie Eggs. 
🍬〓Trick or Treat〓: Use your collected ingredients to make Strange Candy! You can exchange Strange Candy for gifts that you can send to friends in your Alliance. 
🎁〓Gift Party〓: Use Surprise Milk Candy and Strange Candy to send heartfelt gifts to your Alliance buddies! There are so many gifts to redeem for including the Ghost Fiesta limited cosmetic items and the Core Immortal Selection Chest [Earth·Lightning·Wind]. Gather your courage and send gift requests to your allies! 
🌟〓Exclusive Pack〓: A special Ghost Fiesta pack will be on sale! The Exclusive Pack comes in multiple grades. After purchasing the current pack, the next grade's pack will be unlocked. The Ghost Fiesta limited Avatar Frame “The Shriek”, the Ghost Fiesta limited Chat Msg Box “Naughty Laufey”, the Ghost Fiesta limited Territory Decoration “Night Phantoms” are all there! 
🍭〓Candy Feast: Packs containing Surprise Milk Candy will be on sale at the Shop. Collect Surprise Milk Candy and send surprise gifts to your Alliance buddies! 

Servers that have been open for 7 days or more can take part in the Ghost Fiesta event. Collect ingredients, make delicious candies, and send gifts to all your friends! See you! 🥰

notes.title: Harvest Festival Event is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Dear Lords,

The Harvest Festival will begin on July 29th and last until August 4th (the event will last for the first 5 days, and the sixth day is the settlement day in which you can continue to claim and exchange rewards).

✅〓Daily Sign-in: obtain rewards by logging into the game each day.
🪺〓Holiday Tasks: complete tasks to obtain Stellar Fruit (used to make Stellar Juice). Once your task completion progress reaches certain points, you can get a progress chest that contains Harvest Coins.
🙈〓Special Drops: there's a chance to obtain Harvest Chests by either collecting resources, gathering resources, defeating Gnome armies or Bosses during the event. Harvest Chest contains Stellar Fruit.
🥤〓Squeeze Juice: squeeze the Stellar Fruit you collected into Stellar Juice! Stellar Juice can be exchanged for rewards. Once you squeeze enough juice, you can get a progress chest and obtain awesome rewards.
🎁〓Reward Exchange: exchange Harvest Coins and Stellar Fruits for your favorite gifts. This can be exchanged for Harvest Festival Decorations (Territory Decoration, Avatar Frame, Nameplate and Chat Msg Box ), Philosopher's Stones, and other great rewards!
😍〓Harvest Festival Limited-Time Gift: the Harvest Festival Limited-Time Gift includes three tiers, you can purchase the gift pack of each tier once a day. This gift pack contains tons of Harvest Coins!

This festival is available for servers that have been open for more than 7 days. Let's collect lots of Stellar Fruits and make yummy juice together! See you on July 29th!🥰
